title: Scout every configured provider key and classify its liveness
goal: Enumerate every configured provider credential from the sources susi already reads, probe each with the cheapest possible call (a models list or a one-token completion), and classify it live, expired, unauthorized, rate-limited or unknown with the evidence kept. Never delete a key (Mandate 56): a dead key is marked, not removed. The probe must cost effectively nothing and be safe to run on a schedule, including when many keys are dead.
